mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN INSTR(C.NR_ITEM_NM, '>') = 0 THEN C.NR_ITEM_NM ELSE LEFT(C.NR_ITEM_NM, INSTR(C.NR_ITEM_NM, '>') - 1) END AS title, CASE WHEN INSTR(C.NR_ITEM_NM, '>') = 0 THEN B.REC_CNTE ELSE SUBSTRING(C.NR_ITEM_NM, INSTR(C.NR_ITEM_NM, '>') + 2) || ' : ' || B.REC_CNTE END AS content FROM ODS.S_MRNNRFAD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRFAE B ON A.NREC_ID = B.NREC_ID AND B.LST_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRIAM C ON B.NR_ITEM_ID = C.NR_ITEM_ID WHERE A.PT_NO || '_' || A.REC_WRT_DTM::DATE || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ = #{keyId} AND A.NREC_FORM_CD = '501' ORDER BY C.SORT_SEQ

SELECT B.STF_NM AS writerNm FROM ODS.S_MRNNRFAD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_CNLRRUSD B ON A.FSR_STF_NO = B.STF_NO WHERE A.PT_NO || '_' || A.REC_WRT_DTM::DATE || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ = #{keyId} AND A.NREC_FORM_CD = '501'
